name: CMS Analytics And Embeds
description: The site-wide integration keys on a screen of their own: the analytics measurement id, the Givebutter account id, and the raw head/body HTML boxes. All of these were always real editable data on settings.json, but the CMS settings form renders inputs for five scalar keys and round-trips the rest untouched — so setting any of them meant a developer and a deploy. The Givebutter account id is the newest and follows the same narrow, template-owned split as the analytics id: an editor types a key, never a script tag, because the box beneath it (Custom head HTML) is the inject-anything escape hatch where a typo is a broken head on every page. Blank means the site loads no Givebutter code at all, which is the shipping default for a site with no giving platform. Note the View-on-site control: this collection is declared as having no page of its own, so it reads 'This content has no page of its own' rather than offering a link — it configures every page, so there is no single page to send an editor to.
